description: Every Airtable surface a CLI should have — plus a local SQLite mirror, cross-base SQL, and webhook tooling no SDK ships.

novel_features.name: Cross-base SQL over local mirror
novel_features.description: Run arbitrary SQL over a local SQLite mirror of one or more Airtable bases. Tables surface as `<base_slug>__<table_slug>`; linked-record arrays are stored as JSON columns you can `json_each()` over.

novel_features.name: What-changed analytics window
novel_features.description: Joins the synced webhook_payloads table with the current records snapshot to report what fields changed across a base in the last N hours/days, grouped by table, field, or actor.

novel_features.name: Stale-record finder
novel_features.description: Find records older than a duration, optionally filtered by a singleSelect status field, joined against the local cache's last_modified_time.

novel_features.name: Schema-drift watcher (multi-base)
novel_features.description: Compare cached schemas of every base under the active profile against a fresh fan-out of `bases get_schema`; report added, removed, and renamed tables and fields. Exit 1 on drift for CI.

novel_features.name: Webhook fleet manager
novel_features.description: List every webhook on every base under the active profile (or across `--all-profiles`), sorted by time-until-expiration, with last-payload age.

novel_features.name: Linked-record graph traversal
novel_features.description: Walk linked-record relationships from a starting record up to a depth limit; render as a tree (`--pretty`) or as ndjson edges (`--json`).

novel_features.name: Record revision history from webhook payloads
novel_features.description: Reconstruct a record's edit timeline (field-level diffs in cursor order) from the synced webhook_payloads table.
